provenance.identity_authority: Actual nine running hashes, the two canonical manifests and frozen measurement-tool hashes. Legacy labels in the template manifest are not current build evidence; the original archive is preserved.

artifact_bytes.scope: Executable or wrapper files only; original shared libraries/interpreted code, compression, package contents and retained recovery copies are not included. Not firmware or flash savings.

retry.reason: Initial C2 was invalid at the first fw4 stdout byte check, not a performance rejection.
retry.diagnosis_limit: Actual failing child bytes were not retained. Later output and IPv6 address sets changed; exact cause remains unproven.
retry.retry_basis: One predeclared retry for an invalid output window with live network-state variation observed; no promise of stability and no selection on performance.

excluded_windows.name: stock-2-failed-output
excluded_windows.reason: fw4 child stdout failed exact byte validation

excluded_windows.name: stock-2-retry-failed-output
excluded_windows.reason: fw4 child stdout failed exact byte validation

review.scope: Reanalysis of unchanged historical samples; no new device run
review.memory_model: F - 24576 + L - 4*floor(L/8) + S - 4*floor(S/8), KiB; L=Active(file)+Inactive(file), S=SReclaimable; 4 KiB pages
